==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Nuguri''' means "raccoon dog" (너구리) in Korean. 
* Known for his {{ci|Vladimir}} and for his unique builds on it.
** Pioneered building {{ii|Fiendish Codex}} and {{ii|Kindlegem}} early in order to hit maximum cooldown reduction. 
** Later began to play Kleptomancy Vladimir with {{ii|Cull}} and {{ii|Ancient Coin}} purely to maximize gold income. 

=== Individual Awards ===
* LCK Finals MVP x1 (Summer 2020)
* LCK 1st All-Pro Team x2 (Spring 2020, Summer 2020)
